questions.question: For identical procedure tails in isolated rules and partitions, what does call select through absolute partition/rule::proc, relative rule::proc and a bare local proc?
questions.controls: Preserve source owner, current partition/rule, attachment, target existence, and missing rule versus missing proc as separate variants.

questions.question: Does a variable/list-built call target with exactly the literal-control bytes reach the same rule procedure?
questions.controls: Capture literal load rejection independently from computed runtime lookup. Do not replace absent call with a desktop stub.

questions.question: How does call pass fixed/list-expanded arguments containing spaces, braces and namespace separators?
questions.controls: Keep literal argument, supported list expansion and deliberately space-joined near miss independent. Acceptance is not execution.

questions.question: Does binding change at load, attachment, or each invocation when an isolated provider rule is replaced or detached?
questions.controls: Retain old/new exact provider and caller inputs, ordered administrative operations, attachment and reached event. Fresh calls and active frames are different questions.

questions.question: Which local/static::/qualified cells do rule-procedure calls read or write across caller and provider rules?
questions.controls: Distinct sentinels and read/write pairs, TMM/unit/connection IDs, independent connections and explicit lifecycle. Do not assume a C Tcl namespace model.
